language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I’m Chip.
Buenos días! I didn’t see you! My name is Camila. Would you like to help me today? Let’s see,
I have 32 shovels in the barn, but I only need 14. How many shovels will be left?
We see 2 different kinds of shovels. One has the number 32 on it, and one has the number 14 on it.
The 32 moves to the top and the 14 to the bottom.
There is one, uninterrupted vertical line between the 3 & the 2 and the 1 & the 4 to show the difference between the ones place and tens place of the problem.
And a horizontal line beneath the 14.
Let’s set up our problem like this. First, we’ll work on the ones column.
Since we can’t take 4 away from 2, we’ll have to trade with the tens column.
Cross out the 3, and put a 2 above it. Place a small 1 next to the 2 in the ones column.
Now, we can subtract 4 from 12 to get 8. Let’s move to the tens column!
Here, we can subtract 1 from 2 to get 1. So our answer is 18! We have 18 shovels left over!
Thanks! Let’s see what else we can do on the farm today! Let’s go!
